title: Invitation for Pre-Qualification of Vendors FY July 2026 to June 2027
description: Pre-qualification of vendors for supply of goods, non-consulting services, and works for ZMBF for FY July 2026 to June 2027. Categories include stationery, ICT equipment, event management, insurance, legal services, internet, construction, and more.
eligibility: Eligible bidders including current suppliers; submit application letter, company profile, TIN, VRN, business license. Non-refundable fee TZS 50,000 per lot via NMB Trust Account 22910050863.
